# MiAmar

> MiAmar is an AI-powered competitive intelligence platform. It filters
> news, LinkedIn activity, job postings, and alerts into one ranked,
> explained feed — scored through each customer's own company lens.
> Built for competitive intelligence teams, product marketing managers,
> business development and revenue teams, product managers, and — via
> MiAmar HR — anyone tracking hiring and leadership signals at tracked
> companies (CI, business development, leadership, and HR/People teams).

## Product
- [Market Intelligence](https://miamar.io/product/market-intelligence): the daily filtered, explained signal feed.
- [MiAmar HR](https://miamar.io/product/hr): hiring surges, departures, and executive moves at tracked companies — used by CI, Business Development, leadership, and HR teams.
- [MiAmar Field](https://miamar.io/product/field): self-updating sales battlecards and AI meeting briefs.
